executive_assessment.text: Coastal secondary roads face storm, flood and rising-sea risks that threaten access to schools, health facilities and markets.
Isolated communities' reliance on secondary roads makes service and market access particularly sensitive to road disruption.
SCORE proposes road upgrades across all four states alongside asset management, emergency-response capacity and road safety.
